offers_products.reason: Sells engineering and consulting services; Delta digital tools support projects but are not a main product.

offers_services.reason: Engineering, environmental, water infrastructure design, project management and IT/cyber services for government and commercial clients.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are government agencies, defense departments, utilities and commercial firms, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Government Services Group serves federal, state, municipal and DoD clients; Commercial/International Group serves commercial clients.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes mostly from project-based engineering and consulting contracts, though some are multi-year government programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Water, environmental and defense work is largely government-funded and mandated, so it is relatively resilient in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Engineering and consulting engagements are billed over time through ongoing contracts, not as single large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for engineers', scientists' and technical specialists' time and expertise; the work would stop without staff.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are U.S. federal and other governments, the Department of Defense and large commercial and utility clients.

asset_heavy.reason: It is a consulting and engineering firm that needs offices and people, not plants or fleets, to grow.
